description: A run on a thread whose origin is a Space is not a chat turn. Session Core drops it before the outbox insert, so the review never receives it. The envelope carries no origin, so capability-core cannot re-check it; this case is covered by that upstream gate.
upstream: session-core src/learning_events.rs: a run whose thread origin is not chat is dropped before the outbox insert (memory_state_and_origin_gates_precede_the_outbox_insert)
